column1: # Complete package source evidence for parser-format-package.

column5: The complete leaf package is transcreated across tidb-datatype and tidb-ast: stateful indent/flat formatting with byte-preserving template and value fragments, Go's single-call writer result semantics, output escaping, all 21 restore flags and source priority, Unicode-15 simple-rune casing generated from Go unicode.CaseRanges, writer-bound restore methods, special comments, and scoped CTE tracking; downstream AST-node packages are not credited.
